Real Characters comprise seven subcategories including Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians representing the largest real-character segment. Custom Characters occupy a small portion with no labeled subcategories.

The figure presents a pie chart illustrating the distribution of characters in RoleplayPref, categorized into three main groups: Virtual Characters, Real Characters, and Custom Characters. The chart consists of a central circle divided into three sections, surrounded by an outer ring with 13 subcategories. Virtual Characters make up a large portion, with Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, which appear to be roughly 33%, 23%, 7%, 7%, and 23% respectively, although exact percentages are not provided. Real Characters comprise seven subcategories: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers, with Musicians and Influencers and Actors being smaller and roughly equal in size. Custom Characters occupy a small section. The chart does not include a legend, but the colors help distinguish between the main categories and subcategories, with Virtual Characters in shades of blue, Real Characters in shades of green, and Custom Characters in red. The segments are ordered in a clockwise direction, starting with Comic Characters at the top. Overall, the chart provides a visual representation of the character distribution in RoleplayPref, highlighting the relative proportions of each category and subcategory.
